title: 第3章 丹炉吞果始化妖第4章 逃出生天得神通
content_zh:
炼丹？
修行？
狭窄空间内，莫凡一愣，外面的对话令他对这个世界有了初步的了解。
自己似乎真的来到了一个可以修行的世界？
想到这里，莫凡心中便没来由的一阵火热。
修行，是他以前想都不敢想的事，可现在却让他看到了一丝希望。
不过很快他却又无奈一叹。
这他妈都快被人给炼丹了，能不能活着都不知道，还修行个屁啊！
“不，逃出去，一定要逃出去！”
莫凡在颓废了一阵后，心中却又极度不甘，开始为自己打气。
就这样，随着时间的推移，他又先后听到了一些对话，得知了自己似乎处于某一个宗门之中。
而且他和另外两个倒霉蛋此刻应该被关在一个名为‘灵兽袋’的空间内。
“砰！砰！”
不知过了多久，又是两声坠落的声响传来。
莫凡明白是另外两个“五毒”被关了进来，也就是蝎子和壁虎。
正想着，突然莫凡感到后背一阵疼痛传出，仿佛被什么东西狠狠地咬了一口，可紧接着对方却又惨叫起来，口中发出“叽叽叽”的声响。
“妈的，定是那死壁虎偷袭老子！”
莫凡心中大怒，抬起后腿便猛地一发力，直接蹬在身后。
砰！
“叽叽叽——”

果然，随着这一腿蹬出去，他顿时便感到有东西飞了出去，同时又传出一连串的惨嚎。
“咦，你们居然还在打架？”
就在这时，一道稚嫩的声音响起，接着莫凡便感到一阵天旋地转，然后眼前一亮。
这是出了灵兽袋了？
好机会啊！
莫凡两只鼓胀的眼珠子往周围一打量，入眼所见的便是一个半人来高的青铜炉，一旁有着一个身穿素裙的小女孩，大约十一二岁。
其他四只毒虫刚一出现便直接四散而逃。
莫凡却是没有动弹，依然趴在原地，因为他明白这个人畜无害的小女孩一定不会让他们轻易逃跑。
果然，只见那小女孩随手一招，四只毒虫顿时倒飞而回，在空中不停摆动着身躯，像是被一股无形的力量束缚住了一般。
“咯咯咯咯……你们这些小家伙不乖了啊，还没这只蛤蟆可爱。”
“虽然我也很想放了你们，可若是真把你们放了，就没办法向师尊交代了，所以你们还是都给我进炉子里去吧！”
“乖乖的炼成丹药，发挥你们最后的余热！”
content_en:
Alchemy?
Practice?
In the narrow space, Mo Fan was stunned. The conversation outside gave him a preliminary understanding of the world.
It seems that I have really come to a world where I can practice?
Thinking of this, Mo Fan's heart felt hot for no reason.
Cultivation was something he had never dared to think about before, but now it gave him a glimmer of hope.
But soon he sighed helplessly.
This damn person is about to make elixirs. I don’t even know if I can survive. What a waste of practice!
"No, escape, you must escape!"
After being depressed for a while, Mo Fan felt extremely unwilling and began to cheer himself up.
In this way, as time went by, he heard some conversations and learned that he seemed to be in a certain sect.
And he and the other two unlucky guys should be locked in a space called the 'Spirit Beast Bag' at the moment.
"Bang! Bang!"
After an unknown amount of time, two more falling sounds were heard.
Mo Fan understood that the other two "Five Poisons" were imprisoned, namely Scorpion and Gecko.
Just as he was thinking about it, Mo Fan suddenly felt a pain in his back, as if he had been bitten hard by something, but then the other party screamed again, making a "chichijiji" sound from his mouth.
"Damn it, that damn gecko must have attacked me!"
Mo Fan was furious, he raised his hind legs and kicked hard behind him.
Bang!
"Chi chi chi——"
Sure enough, as he kicked out, he immediately felt something fly out, and at the same time a series of miserable howls came out.
"Hey, you guys are still fighting?"
At this moment, a childish voice sounded, and then Mo Fan felt the world spin for a while, and then his eyes lit up.
Is this out of the spirit beast bag?
What a great opportunity!
Mo Fan looked around with his bulging eyes, and what he saw was a bronze furnace half a man tall. Next to it was a little girl in a plain skirt, about eleven or twelve years old.
The other four poisonous insects scattered and fled as soon as they appeared.
Mo Fan did not move, still lying on the spot, because he knew that this harmless little girl would not let them escape easily.
Sure enough, with a casual move by the little girl, the four poisonous insects immediately flew back, swinging in the air as if bound by an invisible force.
"Giggle, giggle... you little guys are not so good, you are not as cute as this toad."
"Although I really want to let you go, if I really let you go, I won't be able to explain it to Master, so you should all go into the furnace!"
"Be obedient and refine the elixir, and use your last remaining heat!"
